<?php
class ProducerBase224 { public $tag=9; public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER-END;"; } public function capture($saved,$ignored) { echo "PRODUCER:",self::class,":",static::class,";"; return $saved; } } class ProducerChild224 extends ProducerBase224 {}
function shift224() { $GLOBALS["argument"]=new New224; $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class Old224 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New224 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Magic224 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["argument"]=null; echo "HANDLER:",($arguments[0] instanceof Old224)?"OLD;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$argument=new Old224; $owner=new Magic224; $result=$owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable([new ProducerChild224,"capture"]))($argument,shift224())); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";

<?php
class Zero224 { public function capture() { echo "ZERO;"; return 7; } public function __destruct() { echo "ZERO-END;"; } }
class MagicZero224 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo ($arguments[0]===1 && $arguments[1]===7)?"HANDLER;":"BAD;"; return false; } }
$owner=new MagicZero224; $result=$owner->MiSsInG(1,(\Closure::fromCallable([new Zero224,"capture"]))()); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";
